_what: The notify step of the Corners machine (Mini Project 2, pair 5, C-18): spec for the Make or n8n scenario. It is a written spec, NOT an export of a running scenario. Replace it with the real export once the scenario exists, and keep this file as the one the company can read.

_data_rule: Invented test data only. Test addresses use example.com, which is reserved and delivers nowhere. No real student, partner or staff address, name or id appears in this repo.

trigger.when: A new row appears in the lead table
trigger.table_owner: Store pair (C-17). Field names below are placeholders until that table is fixed.

steps.name: Welcome email to the student
steps.does: Sends the welcome email with the personal first-week checklist link from the lead magnet (pair 1)
steps.text: Voice rule (PROJECT.md): short sentences, no 'community' or 'vibes'. Draft in routing.md section 4.
steps.within: 5 minutes of the row being created

steps.name: Alert to the owner
steps.does: Sends one alert to one named owner (rule R2 in routing.md)
steps.within: 5 minutes of the row being created

steps.name: Day-limit reminder
steps.runs_when: kind = partner AND no reply logged 24 hours after created_at
steps.does: Reminds the owner once; if still no reply logged 48 hours after created_at, tells Operations
steps.reason: The promise is 'the right person follows up within a day'. A promise nobody checks is a hope.

steps.name: Unrouted lead
steps.runs_when: no rule matches (unknown kind, empty cohort code, enrich flagged the row as wrong)
steps.does: Writes the lead_id to the weekly review list. Sends nothing to anyone outside the twelve.

error_route.applies_to: N1, N2, N3 (any step that calls an outside service)
error_route.then: Alert to Operations with: scenario name, step id, run id, error text, lead_id. No address, name or free text.
error_route.and_then: The lead stays in the lead table marked 'notify failed' so the weekly review finds it
error_route.owner: Operations (company.js: Operations owns the pilot, moderation and data)

test_plan.data: Ten invented sign-ups (test-01 to test-10 at example.com), three invented partner leads, one forced failure

pass_marks_set_before_the_run.partner_alerts: 3 of 3 reach the right owner within 5 minutes
pass_marks_set_before_the_run.forced_failure: 1 of 1 reported to Operations within 15 minutes, with a run id
pass_marks_set_before_the_run.personal_data_in_alerts: 0 addresses, names or free text in any alert

test_plan.counts_not_percentages: Under 30 records, so every result is written as a count
test_plan.run_by: A person outside the pair, from 04 - Playbooks/incidents.md alone
